An umbrella, not a single right 1 Several claims, one label. Publicity, passing off, privacy, defamation, and trade mark or copyright rights, including performers' rights. 2 Each keeps its own test. Bundling them doesn't lower the bar, especially for restraining speech before trial. 3 Mere use of identity isn't unlawful. Liability depends on the specific claim. 4 Publicity can be licensed; privacy, dignity and reputation are personal and can't be assigned. "The rights are available to every individual."
